newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thyssen 5 mth group sales down three pct.
newsitem.headline: Thyssen 5 mth group sales down three pct.

text.p: Group sales at German steel and engineering group Thyssen AG declined three percent in the first five months of its 1996/97 business year to 14.6 billion marks, chairman Dieter Vogel told the company's annual shareholders' meeting on Friday.
The decline largely resulted from the sale of subsidiaries. On a comparable basis, sales rose two percent, Vogel said, according to the text of a speech prepared for delivery at the meeting.
Incoming orders in the October-February period were down one percent, but were two percent higher when corrected for the sale of the subsidiaries.
In reorganising to concentrate on core activities, Thyssen sold its Walzdraht Hochfeld and Ruhrort steel units, among others.
The spinoffs also reduced the workforce to 111,200, down 9.3 percent from the end of September.
